'''Mist canister''' was an item that could be used in combat to spread mist on the battle field to distract the opponent. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] used this item to help the [[Hand of Judgment]] to capture [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard]] when the Governor tried to separate [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
